description: Find recordings by email, profileId, current user traits, recording dates, pages, timeline text, events, activity, or watch score. Use known trait values; ask if unknown. Dates refer to visits. Returns watch links, newest first.

category.description: What the visitor was mainly doing, as classified per session.

days.description: Recordings started in the last N days, unless explicit startedAfter/startedBefore bounds are supplied (recordings expire after 30).

email.description: Exact identified-user email, case-insensitive; combine with traits or profileId to narrow it.

event.description: Only sessions where this custom event fired, e.g. signup_completed. Find event names with get_data or execute_sql_query on custom_events.

issue.description: Only sessions with this unanswered-click issue, as `{path}:{element}`: the part after `friction:` in a replay_friction signal key.

limit.description: How many recordings to return, newest first.

minWatchScore.description: Only sessions scored at least this worth watching (0-3; 2 = a clear moment of struggle).

page.description: Only sessions that visited a path containing this, e.g. /pricing.

person.description: Case-insensitive partial match on an identified user's email, name, or profile ID.

profileId.description: The stable profile ID supplied by the site with user identification.

sessionId.description: One recording by its sessionId (from a replay link's session parameter). Also returns the timeline around each unanswered click.

startedAfter.description: Inclusive recording start timestamp with timezone.

startedBefore.description: Exclusive recording start timestamp with timezone.

text.description: Only sessions whose timeline mentions this (case-insensitive): a clicked button or link label, a typed field, or a page path.

traits.description: Current user traits, all of which must match, such as role=editor or region=eu. These do not describe past trait values.

withFriction.description: Only sessions with clicks the page never answered.

name: search_replays
title: Search replays
